releases.notes:
**Movement fixes, inventory improvements and more protocol translation fixes!**

**Movement**
* Fixed many liquid movement issues in versions **1.15.2 and earlier**. (Thanks @lowercasebtw)
* Fixed collision pushing in versions **1.16.1 and earlier**. (Also thanks @lowercasebtw)
* Fixed suffocation pushing in versions **1.13.2 and earlier**. (Also thanks @lowercasebtw)
* Fixed a movement input calculation issue in versions **1.13.2 and earlier**.
* Fixed boat teleportation and smaller boat handling issues in version **1.8.x**.
* Fixed teleports not being applied while riding a vehicle in versions **1.21.1 and earlier**.
* Living entities now use linear interpolation in versions **26.2 and earlier**. (Thanks @lowercasebtw)
* Fixed negative jump boost effects in versions **1.20.4 and earlier**.

**Combat**
* Fixed the fall damage calculation (e.g. wrong fall sounds after long falls) in versions **1.21.4 and earlier**. (Thanks @lowercasebtw)
* Fixed jump boost not increasing the safe fall distance in versions **1.20.4 and earlier**. (Also thanks @lowercasebtw)
* Fixed hitting fireballs not applying the attack slowdown in versions **1.20.4 and earlier**. (Also thanks @lowercasebtw)
* Fixed the player death animation in versions **1.14.4 and earlier**.

**Inventories & Items**
* Fixed various inventory actions (e.g. shift-clicking in furnaces, brewing stands and chests) in older versions. (Thanks @Socketlike)
* Allowed middle-clicking in inventories outside of creative mode in versions **1.17.1 and earlier**. (Thanks @lowercasebtw)
* Fixed item dropping prediction in versions **1.13 and earlier**. (Also thanks @lowercasebtw)
* Fixed the brushing animation of suspicious blocks not showing the item in versions **1.20.4 and earlier**.
* Fixed hidden attribute modifiers being lost on items in versions **1.21.4 and earlier**.
* Fixed armor trim data in versions **1.20.4 and earlier**.
* Fixed invalid enchantments and hidden item flags in version **1.17**.
* Fixed legacy brewing ingredients not being handled properly in versions **26.2 and earlier**.
* Fixed explorer map names and item models in versions **26.2 and earlier**.
* Improved handling of invalid item data sent by servers, fixing kicks and other issues across versions.

**Other changes**
* Liquids now dampen light by 3 levels in versions **1.12.2 and earlier**, like in the original client. (Thanks @lowercasebtw)
* Fixed name tags not shifting down for players in versions **1.13.2 and earlier**.
* Fixed allay and mannequin movement interpolation in versions **26.2 and earlier**.
* Fixed a network protocol error caused by unknown damage type tags in versions **26.2 and earlier**.
* Fixed the client brand not being sent again after a server switch (e.g. on Velocity) in versions **1.20.1 and earlier**.
* Fixed entities not being removed properly in versions **1.16.2 to 1.16.5**.
* Fixed some entity sounds (e.g. zombie pigmen) not playing in older versions.
* Fixed projectile spawn data and invalid entity status flags in version **1.8.x**.
* Removed a redundant entity velocity packet in versions **1.13.2 and earlier**.
* Fixed particles in timeline registry data not being handled properly.
* Fixed item icons not being drawn properly in the version selection screen.
* Fixed vanilla clients not being able to join LAN worlds opened with ViaFabricPlus.
* Fixed entities using the wrong version while a singleplayer world is starting.
* Improved performance of chunk and item handling.
* Updated translations from Crowdin.

Please also read the **[5.1.3 changelog](https://github.com/ViaVersion/ViaFabricPlus/releases/tag/5.1.3)**.

Your support means a lot! If you'd like to help keep the project going, consider donating at:

https://florianreuth.de/donate

I'll continue improving this project to the best of my ability.

releases.notes:
**Collision fixes, UI improvements and more!**

**Bedrock Edition support**

To use Bedrock edition, install the [ViaFabricPlus Bedrock Edition addon](https://modrinth.com/mod/viafabricplus-bedrock), which restores support for Bedrock Edition that was removed in the 5.0.0 release. The addon now supports Bedrock Edition **1.26.60**.

**New features**
* Merged the ClassiCube and BetaCraft buttons into a single server lists button.
* Added a close button to popups.

**Collisions**
* Fixed wall block collisions in version **1.8.x**.
* Cleaned up the wall and fence collision logic in versions **1.12.2 and earlier** to match the original client. (Thanks @lowercasebtw)

**Other changes**
* Fixed armor trim item sprites not being displayed properly in versions **1.21.8 and earlier**.
* Fixed the footstep particle workaround for versions **1.12.2 and earlier** also being applied in newer versions.
* Fixed the settings command not working in versions **1.12.2 and earlier**.
* Fixed registry data being modified after it was sent during configuration.
* Improved performance when sending raw packets.
* Updated translations from Crowdin.

Please also read the **[5.1.2 changelog](https://github.com/ViaVersion/ViaFabricPlus/releases/tag/5.1.2)**.

Your support means a lot! If you'd like to help keep the project going, consider donating at:

https://florianreuth.de/donate

I'll continue improving this project to the best of my ability.

releases.notes:
**New features and more protocol translation fixes!**

**New features**
* Added a favorites tab to the version selection screen, allowing you to mark versions as favorites.
* Added wool color selection to the block selection screen in Classic versions.
* Added an "Allow item usage while mining" visual setting for version **1.8.x** (disabled by default). (Also thanks @lowercasebtw)
* Version names in the version selection screen are now translatable, and release dates now use your system's date format. (Also thanks @Andepthy)
* The ClassiCube server list search now also matches server IPs. (Thanks @shunoni)

**Movement**
* Living entities now use client-side movement simulation in versions **1.7.10 and earlier**, like in the original client. (Thanks @lowercasebtw)

**Items**
* Fixed inventory desyncs caused by incorrect item hashing (e.g. consumable animations, default-count item templates and sulfur cube content).
* Fixed hidden item components being shown in chat item hovers.
* Fixed some item sounds not being translated properly across versions.
* Fixed items displayed in block entities not being handled.
* Fixed inventory desyncs caused by attribute modifiers in versions **1.20.6 and earlier**.
* Fixed duplicated item data in versions **1.20.4 and earlier**.
* Fixed villager trades with removed items not being handled properly in versions **1.20.4 and earlier**.
* Fixed nested item markers leaking into custom item data in versions **1.20.4 and earlier**.
* Fixed written books with invalid filtered pages causing errors in versions **1.20.2 and earlier**.
* Fixed the map number leaking into item data in versions **1.16.5 and earlier**.
* Fixed banners without a pattern color causing errors in versions **1.12.2 and earlier**.
* Fixed spawn eggs losing their existing entity data in versions **1.12.2 and earlier**.
* Fixed empty item data being left behind on items in versions **1.12.2 and earlier**.
* Fixed empty item data being left behind on items in version **1.8.x**.

**Creative mode**
* Fixed item names not being restored properly on items with a custom name.
* Fixed map colors not being restored in versions **26.2 and earlier**.
* Fixed new map decorations not being handled in versions **26.2 and earlier**.
* Fixed the shield `bypassed_by` tag key being lost in versions **1.21.11 and earlier**.
* Fixed bees not spawning from bee nests in versions **1.21.8 and earlier**.
* Fixed hidden additional tooltips disappearing in versions **1.21.4 and earlier**.
* Fixed new 1.20.5 armor trim patterns not being restored in versions **1.20.4 and earlier**.

**Other changes**
* Fixed player markers outside of maps not being rotated in versions **26.2 and earlier**.
* Fixed continuous block breaking sounds in versions **26.2 and earlier**.
* Fixed missing empty swing animations in versions **26.2 and earlier**.
* Fixed custom enchantments with value checks not working in versions **26.2 and earlier**.
* Fixed wall connections in versions **1.12.2 and earlier**.
* Fixed missing statistics in versions **1.16.5 and earlier**.
* Fixed ender dragons flapping their wings way too fast in version **1.8.x**.
* Fixed some custom registry data not being handled properly.
* Fixed version auto-detection failing on network errors.
* Fixed the ClassiCube account not being reset after a failed login. (Thanks @shunoni)
* Removed the deprecated legacy API (`ViaFabricPlus#getImpl` and `ViaFabricPlusBase`) from the developer API.
* The name of `ProtocolTranslation#AUTO_DETECT_VERSION` is now translated in the developer API.
* Updated translations from Crowdin.

Please also read the **[5.1.1 changelog](https://github.com/ViaVersion/ViaFabricPlus/releases/tag/5.1.1)**.

Your support means a lot! If you'd like to help keep the project going, consider donating at:

https://florianreuth.de/donate

I'll continue improving this project to the best of my ability.

releases.notes:
**Mainly 26.3 update fixes!**

**Movement**
* Fixed hopping out of water next to waterlogged blocks in versions **26.2 and earlier**.
* Fixed stepping up blocks next to entities like boats or shulkers in versions **26.2 and earlier**.
* Fixed underwater detection below solid blocks (swimming, sprinting and mining speed) in versions **26.2 and earlier**.
* Fixed water currents pushing players differently in versions **26.2 and earlier**.
* Fixed not being able to start gliding with an elytra in lava in versions **26.2 and earlier**.

**Interactions**
* Fixed hoes and shovels not working while holding a shield in the offhand in versions **26.2 and earlier**.
* Fixed dousing campfires with shovels (e.g. while sneaking) in versions **26.2 and earlier**.
* Fixed items with a use cooldown going on cooldown when used on blocks in versions **26.2 and earlier**.
* Fixed missing hand swings when interacting with shelves, minecarts and wandering traders in versions **26.2 and earlier**.
* Fixed camel interactions sending additional packets in versions **26.2 and earlier**.
* Fixed missing block breaking particles and a duplicated hit sound in versions **26.2 and earlier**.
* Fixed block breaking being aborted when pausing the game or being teleported in versions **26.2 and earlier**.

**Other changes**
* Fixed missing potion splash sounds in versions **26.2 and earlier**.
* Fixed the teleport confirmation packet order in versions **1.21.2 and earlier**.
* Fixed the per-server version not being saved.
* Added missing tags across versions (e.g. fixing rain falling through newly placed blocks).
* Exposed `ProtocolTranslation#setServerVersion` and moved `AUTO_DETECT_VERSION` into `ProtocolTranslation` in the developer API.
* Updated translations from Crowdin.

Please also read the **[5.1.0 changelog](https://github.com/ViaVersion/ViaFabricPlus/releases/tag/5.1.0)**.
